trends.name: RBI to conduct 3‑day Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction
trends.why: Central bank liquidity operation signals monetary policy stance, affecting global bond markets and emerging‑market funding flows.

trends.name: Bank of England raises key rate to 4%
trends.why: A 4% policy rate shifts global risk‑on sentiment, impacts euro‑area borrowing costs, and sets a benchmark for other advanced economies.

trends.name: Bitcoin surges above $80k after ETF listing
trends.why: A significant price jump reflects renewed institutional appetite, affecting crypto‑asset valuations worldwide.

trends.name: AI partnership expansion with Nvidia and workflow builder
trends.why: AI infrastructure deals drive tech sector valuations and shape global AI supply chains.

trends.name: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill citing monetary sovereignty
trends.why: Regulatory stance on crypto affects global crypto market access and cross‑border payment systems.

trends.name: Nigeria’s haulage sector exposed by empty truck trips and cargo delays
trends.why: Infrastructure bottlenecks constrain trade, impacting Africa’s trade deficit with China and global supply chains.

trends.name: Africa’s $102bn trade deficit with China exposes industrial weakness
trends.why: Highlights structural trade imbalances, influencing global commodity flows and investment patterns.

trends.name: US midterm election results accelerate India‑US trade deal talks
trends.why: Political shift in the US reshapes trade negotiations, affecting global supply chains and investment flows.
